refresh.how: Run scripts/update_templates.py. It resolves the astryx CLI, re-extracts every page skeleton, rewrites templates/pages/, regenerates templates/INDEX.md, and writes this file.
refresh.safe_by_default: Dry-run first. Writing requires --write. A --version pin reproduces an exact release.
refresh.offline: Runtime never uses the network. Only this refresh step does, and only when invoked explicitly.
